caption: The drawing depicts a single metal kitchen tool resembling a biscuit or dough cutter with a circular shape and a scalloped lower edge. It has a round, open cylindrical body and an attached handle made from a wire bent into an elongated loop connected to the side. Inside the circle, a smaller ring connects to the handle’s midpoint, reinforcing the structure. The drawing is done in shades of gray and black, typical of graphite or charcoal on a light, slightly textured, cream-colored background. The details display shadows, highlights, and textured marks indicating the metallic, possibly worn, surface of the object. The artist’s signature, “HELEN HOBART,” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Cookie Cutter
